title: Trade Marks Rules (Practice Direction No. 1 of 2009)
text:
TRADE MARKS
_______________________________________________________________
BELIZE:
PRACTICE DIRECTIONS
No. 1 of 2009
DIRECTIONS made by the Registrar of Intellectual
Property under Rule 60 of the Trade Marks Rules, Chapter
257S of the Subsidiary Laws of Belize, Revised Edition
2003.
Interpretation. 1. In these Practice Directions, unless the context
otherwise requires
“Nice Agreement” means the International Classification
of Goods and Services (as amended).
Classification 2.(1) The Class Headings of the Nice Agreement
of Goods and
indicate in a general manner the fields to which the goods
Services.
and services in an application belong and shall not be
used to classify such goods and services.
(2) The Alphabetical List of Goods and Services and the
Explanatory Notes of the Nice Agreement shall be used to
classify goods and services in an application.
(3) If a product or service cannot be classified with the
aid of the Alphabetical List and the Explanatory Notes of
the Nice Agreement, the following shall be applied-
(a) the General Remarks of the Nice Agreement
(http://www.belipo.bz/e_library.php;

(b) the Identification of Goods and Services Manual
(http://www.uspto.gov).
MADE by the Registrar of Intellectual Property this 23rd day of June, 2009.
(ALHAJI TEJAN-COLE)
Deputy Registrar of Intellectual Property
